hole_diameter = 10.9

from build123d import *

# ---- dimensions (from drawing) ----
arm_length = 80.0
arm_dia = 32.0
boss_dia = 42.7
boss_width = 16.0
boss_start = 32.0          # from left end to boss start
hole_dia = 8.1
hole_depth = 18.8
hole_center_x = 64.0       # from left end
slot_width = 10.7
slot_depth = 8.1

arm_r = arm_dia / 2.0
boss_r = boss_dia / 2.0

# ---- main arm ----
arm = Pos(arm_length / 2.0, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(arm_r, arm_length)

# ---- central boss ----
boss = Pos(boss_start + boss_width / 2.0, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(boss_r, boss_width)

part = arm + boss

# ---- blind hole on +X side ----
hole = Pos(hole_center_x, arm_r - hole_depth / 2.0, 0) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(hole_dia / 2.0, hole_depth)
part = part - hole

# ---- slot on -X end ----
slot = Pos(slot_width / 2.0, -arm_r + slot_depth / 2.0, 0) * Box(slot_width, slot_depth, arm_dia * 0.45)
part = part - slot

part.name = "arm_with_boss_hole_slot"
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

block_length = 80.0
block_width = 49.6
block_thickness = 13.8
pocket_length = 63.8
pocket_width = 36.2
pocket_depth = 8.4
hole_diameter = 4.1
hole_spacing = 13.2
hole_count = 5
corner_hole_diameter = 3.4
corner_offset_x = 5.5
corner_offset_y = 3.9
rib_width = 4.5
rib_length = 12.0
rib_height = 4.8
rib_offset_x = 13.8
big_hole_diameter = 16.5
big_hole_x = 53.8
big_hole_y = 17.9

solid_body = Box(block_length, block_width, block_thickness)

pocket = Pos(0, 0, block_thickness/2 - pocket_depth/2) * Box(pocket_length, pocket_width, pocket_depth)
solid_body = solid_body - pocket

for i in range(hole_count):
    x = (i - (hole_count - 1) / 2) * hole_spacing
    solid_body = solid_body - Pos(x, 0, 0) * Cylinder(hole_diameter/2, block_thickness)

corner_positions = [
    (-block_length/2 + corner_offset_x, -block_width/2 + corner_offset_y),
    (block_length/2 - corner_offset_x, -block_width/2 + corner_offset_y),
    (-block_length/2 + corner_offset_x, block_width/2 - corner_offset_y),
    (block_length/2 - corner_offset_x, block_width/2 - corner_offset_y),
]
for x, y in corner_positions:
    solid_body = solid_body - Pos(x, y, 0) * Cylinder(corner_hole_diameter/2, block_thickness)

rib = Pos(-block_length/2 + rib_offset_x, 0, -block_thickness/2 + rib_height + rib_height/2) * Box(rib_width, rib_length, rib_height)
solid_body = solid_body + rib

solid_body = solid_body - Pos(big_hole_x - block_length/2, big_hole_y - block_width/2, 0) * Cylinder(big_hole_diameter/2, block_thickness)

part = solid_body
part.name = "block_with_pocket_holes_rib"

front_thk     = 16.0          # front boss thickness
front_back    = 16.7          # back face of front boss

groove_radius = 37.25         # Ø74.5 shallow groove
groove_depth  = 0.9           # groove depth
